notes.title: Year of Good Things, March Elephant Collection Update!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

First off I'm working on a project called The Year of Good Things! It's a Kickstarter that is live now, would love your support to work on twelve brand-new games in the classic Flash spirit. All the games will be wrapped up and brought to Steam in the future!

[b]Back on [url=https://bit.ly/theyearofgoodthings]Kickstarter[/url][/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083355/20dec05d885b31dd73bdeac1c9f37aadf2998b3c.png[/img]

Second, updates on The Elephant Collection!

[b]Our current plan is to introduce LOOT! The Game in an upcoming update[/b]. If you have never played LOOT! The Game, its a Diablo-esque train chase... with guns!? Its a little wild and my last Flash game while at Armor Games, so a bookend to my time and career at the company.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083355/52b17cc45e03fe7ab1afeee5620857aac3ecf500.png[/img]

As we started thinking about where we should be adding games we thought about taking the elevator down... meaning we'll be adding a basement floor to the building to give us some space to add new games and achievements. Right now we're considering up to two non-elephant games to also include in the basement.

Timing for these updates are a little up in the air at the moment with part of the team out of town and the rest of us a little heads down with the Kickstarter. Like the elephant we won't forget, just got a lot of hamsters in the air right now.

If you have game suggestions for The Elephant Collection please let us know!

notes.title: v1.04 Quick fixes based on early feedback
notes.content:
Thanks for all your great early feedback players, this is a quick little update that fixes a few bugs. 

v1.04  (You can see your current version number in the top left of the screen when you first launch the game)

- If your 'Achievement Unlocked 3' Steam Achievement has not unlocked when it should have try going back into the game and it should unlock!

-A fix to allow for the ":-)" achievement on 'Achievement Unlocked 2' to be earned with some non-English Keyboards (thanks for pointing that out!)

-A fix to address a certain crash on 'Achievement Unlocked 3' if you were a bit too eagar to get into the game!

-A few other bits and pieces!

We've loved hearing from you and how lovely you all are!
